primer: Texas Instruments (TXN) earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS on business quality, backed by an 80,000-product analog catalog and 22.04% ROIC. Its 300mm wafer fabs and >80% direct TI.com sales drove Q3 2026 revenue up 28% YoY to $6.06B. Gross margin hit 64.2% and TTM FCF reached $8.42B, though 194-day inventory and the $7.5B Silicon Labs deal warrant PASS_WITH_WATCH. At $303.60 (26.06x Fwd P/E) in a 6-distribution-day Correction, new capital is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT at $278.00-$286.00 (2.46:1 asymmetry to $345.00). Existing 1.6917 Schwab shares remain HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at $262.00.
